title: Newmark Arranges Over 65,000 Square Feet of Class A Office Leases at The Offices at Bedminster in New Jersey
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged over 65,350 square feet of office lease transactions at The Offices at Bedminster, a two-building Class A campus at 500 and 550 Hills Drive in Bedminster, New Jersey.
